metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Bedlam gate standing open, a figure of two hundred, and a smaller piece of bread.

yesterday: The Bedlam gate was standing open. The hasp was wrenched. A cap was in the road. Backs were running north.
The water-bearer's story of the Lord Mayor and words about the dearth is talk.
Margery's figure is two hundred. Cowley and Larkham agree that people ran toward the noise.
At two you played Richard the Third.
At supper Verbeke said the man is a silkweaver, like himself, and English, and so it is not yet us. He cut his bread smaller. The household stayed at the table.
